en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Tenko.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.

I-I never dreamed I'd actually be able
to leave this place!

Fall in love with someone to escape?
That was impossible for me from the start!

But I know you've changed, Tenko.
A lot has happened in a short time...

...Yeah, I did change. Well, my opinion
of degenerate males changed, anyway.

Before, I'd rather die than breathe
the same air as males...

But now, I can tolerate breathing the same
air as them...as long as they get a sex change!

<CLT=cltMIND>...She didn't change
all *that* much...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I'm sure it's a big
change for Tenko.

You're the reason why I changed so
much, you know that?

You made me realize something I didn't
want to know...

That's why I experienced such a huge
change of heart...
I did?
Huh!?
You didn't forget, did you!?

Of course you remember! Since you went
through so much to change me, right!?

<CLT=cltMIND>The thing that made Tenko
change was...
She saw males are human too
She saw how great men can be
She realized her master is male
You saw that males are human too?
A-Are you making fun of me!?

I already knew degenerate males were
human beings!

That's one reason why I detested them
so much!

<CLT=cltMIND>That sounds like an
even bigger problem...

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
What changed Tenko's mind was...
You saw how great men can be?

If that's true, then you're gonna have
to enlighten me.

But I'm pretty sure you can't tell me
something that doesn't exist.

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
What changed Tenko's mind was...
You realized your master is male.
Yes! That's definitely it!
You opened my Pandora's box!

But because I was able to recognize it,
I ended up maturing.
Maturing?

I found out Neo-Aikido has the power to change
males for the better!
That was a lightning bolt of realization!
If I continue to use Neo-Aikido...

I'd be able to change all degenerate males
into something more than just degenerates!

I'd be able to rid the world of ugly, disgusting
degenerates for good!
Ah...I see.

So, then!
Shuichi, please master Neo-Aikido!

When you become more than just a degenerate,
I'll stop holding my breath around you!

You were holding your breath
the whole time!?

Oh! If mastering Neo-Aikido is too tough for
you, then a sex change would be a lot faster!
I would definitely prefer the latter!
Ah, y-yeah...I'll think about it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Though I was a bit confused...
I couldn't help but smile back at Tenko.

<CLT=cltMIND>I could feel her belief in me
through her smile.

<CLT=cltMIND>My heart started beating faster
before I even realized it.
<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, Tenko still hates males, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe I...can love...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>Our relationship began in fiction...
but my beating heart is real.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
